title: The Lennon–Pittel conjecture on random stable matchings
abstract: We prove the Lennon–Pittel conjecture for balanced stable marriage with independent, uniform strict preferences. Let S_n count the stable complete matchings between two sides of size n. For every positive nonincreasing sequence epsilon_n tending to zero, the probability that S_n is at least epsilon_n times its expectation tends to one. This gives a lower-tail estimate at the scale of Pittel's first-moment asymptotic. An accompanying working paper is in preparation.
